metaTitle: Bridal Shower Dessert Cups in Hamilton & the GTA
metaDescription: Bridal shower dessert cups made in Hamilton. Build around a Premium centrepiece, with Saturday delivery to Burlington, Oakville, Mississauga and Toronto.
h1: Bridal shower dessert cups, built around a Premium centrepiece
intro: Our bridal shower dessert cups are hand-layered in Hamilton and made fresh the morning of pickup or delivery. For a shower, start with a Premium flavour as the centrepiece, set Classic cups around it, and choose the pack that fits your guest list.

sections.heading: Pick a Premium centrepiece
sections.body:
A shower table looks finished when the eye has somewhere to land. Pick one or two Premium flavours as the statement and let the rest of the cups support them.

- **[Dubai Chocolate](/menu/dubai-chocolate):** pale green pistachio cream, golden kunafa strands mid-cup, dark ganache and a green marbled pistachio swirl on top. The kunafa sits between two layers of pistachio cream, and some cups are finished with rose petals.
- **[Biscoff Bliss](/menu/biscoff-bliss):** caramel-tan cream under an amber top, with a Biscoff cookie standing upright. The cookie adds height to a row of cups.
- **[Ferrero Royale](/menu/ferrero-royale):** dark glossy ganache crowned with a Ferrero-style hazelnut ball and crushed hazelnut.
- **[Kinder Bueno](/menu/kinder-bueno):** milk-chocolate cream under glossy ganache, finished with a striped Kinder Bueno bite.

Styling tip: group the centrepiece cups together at the front or middle of the table, then set the Classic cups around them so their colours frame the Premium flavours.

Already know your statement flavour? [Start a request with Dubai Chocolate](/order?pack=48&flavour=dubai&event=bridal-shower).

sections.heading: Allergens on a shower guest list
sections.body:
Check allergens before you choose flavours, especially if your centrepiece is Premium. Of the centrepiece flavours above, Kinder Bueno, Ferrero Royale and Dubai Chocolate are flagged for tree nuts; Biscoff Bliss isn't, though cross-contact is possible, so it works for preference, not for an allergy.

{{dietaryClaim}} If the bride or a guest has a nut allergy, another severe allergy or a strict dietary need, message us before you order. There's more on allergens in the [FAQ](/faq).

sections.heading: A Premium-forward 48
sections.body:
Here's a Premium-forward 48 of Dessert Cups (a suggestion, not a rule): 12 Dubai Chocolate and 12 Biscoff Bliss as the centrepiece, with 12 Strawberry Fields, 6 Mango Dream and 6 Blueberry Haze around them. That's five flavours, inside the 48's limit of eight.

This half-Premium, half-Classic mix comes to an estimated $229 before any delivery fee. The [packages page](/packages) shows how a mixed pack is priced.

sections.heading: Three colour stories for the shower table
sections.body:
Match the cups to the shower's colours using what each flavour actually looks like.

**Blush and pistachio.** [Strawberry Fields](/menu/strawberry-fields) brings blush-pink cream, a glossy red compote and cream rosettes. [Dubai Chocolate](/menu/dubai-chocolate) adds pale green, gold kunafa and dark ganache. That's one Classic and one Premium, and 12 of each fills a 24.

**Gold and amber.** [Mango Dream](/menu/mango-dream) is a saffron-orange mango layer over pale yellow cream with a cream dollop. [Biscoff Bliss](/menu/biscoff-bliss) is caramel-tan under an amber top. These warm tones suit a brunch or garden shower, and neither is flagged for tree nuts (cross-contact is still possible; see the allergen notes above).

**Deep chocolate.** [Kinder Bueno](/menu/kinder-bueno), [Ferrero Royale](/menu/ferrero-royale) and Dubai Chocolate make an all-Premium table in milk chocolate, glossy dark ganache and green-gold. All three are flagged for tree nuts, so check the allergen notes above against your guest list.

sections.heading: Sizing it for a 24-guest shower
sections.body:
Mini Shots are 2 oz, a tasting size. Dessert Cups are 5 oz, a full serving. Take a shower of around 24 guests as the example, and treat the ratios as a suggestion rather than a rule:

- **Beside the shower cake or a brunch spread:** about two Mini Shots per guest, so each guest can try the centrepiece and one supporting flavour. That's a 48 of Mini Shots ($88 Classic, $115 Premium).
- **As the dessert itself:** about one Dessert Cup per guest. That's a 24 of Dessert Cups ($99 Classic, $129 Premium), with room for up to 4 flavours.

Whichever you choose, mention any allergies in your notes. [Start a 48 of Mini Shots for your shower](/order?pack=48&size=2oz&event=bridal-shower).

For a bigger guest list, every size, price and pack perk is on the [packages page](/packages).

sections.heading: Planning the shower and the wedding together
sections.body:
If you're also ordering cups for the wedding, the shower makes a useful preview. Order Mini Shots in the flavours you're considering for the wedding day, and see which ones the table finishes first.

Each event has its own date, so each one is its own request with its own notice: 48 hours for a 24 or 48, and at least 7 days for a 96. Mention the other event in the notes on each request.

For the wedding itself, see [wedding dessert cups](/events/weddings).

sections.heading: From request to shower day
sections.body:
Here's how the timing works.

- **Once you know the colours and a rough guest count:** pick your size, pack and flavours on the [order page](/order?pack=48&event=bridal-shower), then add the date and your notes, including the colours and any allergies. The total shown is an estimate before delivery.
- **At least 48 hours ahead (7 days for a 96):** send the request. Under 48 hours counts as urgent, subject to availability, with a rush fee; a 96 isn't offered on shorter notice.
- **Within the day:** we confirm by email, text or Instagram, with your total, including the delivery fee if you chose delivery, and how to pay the deposit that confirms your order.
- **The morning of pickup or delivery:** the cups are made fresh for [pickup in Hamilton](/dessert-cups-hamilton) or [Saturday delivery](/dessert-cups-gta). A 48 comes as two boxes of 24, with no lids. Keep the cups refrigerated until the shower; they can sit out for about 2 hours. The [FAQ](/faq) has more on urgent requests and delivery.

faqs.q: Can you deliver to a bridal shower outside Hamilton?
faqs.a: Yes, on Saturdays. We deliver to Burlington, Oakville, Mississauga and Toronto as well as Hamilton, and the delivery fee is quoted as part of your total when we confirm your order. For a shower on another day, pickup is free in Hamilton, by arrangement, and a friend or courier can collect for you.
